verdict.rationale: The evidence never describes employees exercising vested options online. There is no documented strike-price payment and no resulting share issuance. The closest material is the trading-and-settlement module, where participants submit market orders with 'sell to cover' or 'hold all' choices and receive payouts via Airwallex. That is adjacent trading and settlement functionality, not a documented paperless exercise workflow, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an employee, I can exercise my vested options online — including payment and the resulting share issuance — without paper forms
